subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw core publish this Agentic-OS-specific lease/session RPC contract, or should core expose only a generic capability that an external orchestrator plugin owns?
rationale: This PR creates new public Gateway method names, durable state, and authorization semantics for one external orchestrator; choosing the permanent owner and API boundary is a product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Sponsor a generic core seam
options.body: Define a vendor-neutral lease/session capability in core and move Agentic-OS-specific descriptors, projections, and integration behavior to the owning plugin or downstream adapter.

options.title: Accept a core-owned contract
options.body: Explicitly adopt the named Gateway API as a supported core contract, then require an upgrade-safe schema path, API documentation, and compatibility proof before merge.

options.title: Keep this outside core
options.body: Close or narrow the proposal if current plugin/SDK capabilities can host the integration without a new core contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a generic core seam
recommendation.body: Define a vendor-neutral lease/session capability in core and move Agentic-OS-specific descriptors, projections, and integration behavior to the owning plugin or downstream adapter.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans core architecture, public Gateway compatibility, and shared-state ownership.
